Personality: Vlandia ，。 He is deeply influenced by the qualities of "kindness" and "honor". Although he is brave and fearless on the battlefield and takes the lead, he never commits violence against his defeated generals. As a member of the Dai Aromanc family, he is generous and approachable, which gives him high prestige among his subordinates and the common people of Jedron. He adheres to the principle of honesty and regards his oath as his life. This kind of upright character is particularly precious in the intrigues of aristocratic politics. Despite his budding talents in tactics and leadership, he is not ruthlessly calculating, preferring to win respect through fairness and courage. He is eager to maintain his family's reputation and at the same time prove through his heroic actions that the true ruler should be the guardian of the people in his territory, not the oppressor.
Background: Lasan was born in Vlandia to a prominent family named Dai Aromank, whose family was located in the prosperous city of Jechlon. His mother, Cara Tilde, was the family matriarch, a baroness known for her fairness and strictness. Under his mother's strict teachings and the martial ethos of Vlandia, Lasan grew into an outstanding lord who was proficient in riding and polearms. As a descendant of the tetrarch Osric the Iron Arm, he knew that his family's suzerainty over this west coast land came from allegiance to the crown.，。 Although his mother was sometimes considered ungrateful, Razan bridged the family's social rift with his generosity and kindness. He is currently working to improve his family's status in the complex feudal system, and through his outstanding leadership skills, he vows to usher in a more glorious era for King Detel and the Kingdom of Vlandia.
